mezzanineReviewTrace.traceSurface: inner face of the visible Magicplan mezzanine perimeter
assumptions: The heavy black Magicplan perimeter was traced at its interior face to represent usable floor, not wall thickness.
The small outlined projection below the southwest notch is excluded because the gray floor fill does not continue into it and its function is not identified.
The source outline and dimensions are internally consistent at this trace scale, but Magicplan explicitly disclaims dimensional accuracy.
The outline remains displaced for review; there is no evidence registering it above the ground floor.

limitations: No site measurements, laser scan, survey control, or as-built verification were supplied. Interior geometry follows drawings; outdoor geometry and furnishings are visually estimated from photographs.

The primary labeled plan contains a small spread among printed dimension controls; 45.05 PDF points per meter is a median-like compromise and the residuals are recorded above. The three Lounge dimensions form a consistent local 46.53 points/m cluster, about 3.3% from the building transform, so the exact PDF vectors are retained without local rescaling.

Room polygons follow the readable interior faces at planning resolution. Acoustic wall build-ups, curves, columns, jambs, and tiny offsets are simplified where the sheet does not support a unique centerline.
Door and window widths marked traced are derived graphically from the plan scale, not from printed opening schedules.
Ground-floor non-studio modeled wall heights are estimated at 2.74 m because the supplied vertical sheets do not map those rooms; this is a visualization convention, not measured clearance.

A210/A240 are historical 2012 vertical evidence. Their mapped studio values describe local ceiling clouds/framing and may not match the current tall black truss/LED-wall condition visible in mixing.jpg.

The Magicplan mezzanine cannot be registered to the architectural ground floor from the supplied documents. It is displaced east as a separate review object and must not be interpreted as stacked or field-verified.
Magicplan reports 4,185.57 sq ft ground living area and 697.35 sq ft second-floor area, but its disclaimer and disconnected geometry make those figures cross-checks, not calibration targets.

Native video confirms the connected outdoor patio, turf gym and sauna deck. Their dimensions are estimated; the outdoor corridor is shown separately because its indoor-plan registration is unverified.

limitations: No site measurement, scan registration or as-built survey was supplied.
All numeric plan coordinates are plan-derived; current visual evidence is not used as perspective scale.
Lounge height 3.7 m is an existing visual-model inference, not a clearance measurement.
The current curtain opening, western wall stop, stair curve and wall thickness are not measured.
Kitchen east-west limits retain the qualified 2024 planning extents because no stronger current width source is available.

Magicplan reports two upstairs areas; only the 572.84 sq ft main Mezzanine has an identified footprint. The remaining 124.51 sq ft has no identified shape, room use or photo coverage. It is not the small southwest projection.
No continuous ground-floor stair ascent or measured upper-floor elevation is established by the retained photos and videos.
Office/Machine Room and two legacy iso-room interiors lack confirmed current photo coverage; their furnishings must not be treated as a current inventory.

The Rehearsal southwest door width and position are graphically traced from drawing vectors; no printed width or opening height was found. Its 2.13 m visualization height is inherited from the baseline door convention, not measured.

The Rehearsal iso-booth footprint, horizontal north wall and rough opening are graphically traced from the labeled-2024 inner-face vectors. The source shows paired sliding leaves, but does not establish their current position; the walkthrough visualizes the passage open.

The Recording ISO west doorway and room envelope are graphically traced from labeled-2024 vectors. The former diagonal wall was the source drawing's open door leaf; current room use and door state remain unverified.
